mapper.select: SELECT c.*, r.thumbnail AS thumbnail FROM comment c JOIN recipe r ON r.recipe_id = c.recipe_id WHERE c.member_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY c.created_date DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT count(*) FROM comment c JOIN recipe r ON r.recipe_id = c.recipe_id WHERE c.member_id = #{member_id}

select c.*, m.nickname, case when c.board_id is not null then b.title when c.recipe_id is not null then r.title end as title,
case when c.recipe_id is not null then r.thumbnail else 'no_board.png' end as thumbnail
from comment c join member m on c.member_id = m.member_id left join board b on c.board_id = b.board_id left join recipe r on r.recipe_id = c.recipe_id where 1=1
and ( m.nickname like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') )
and c.status = #{status}
order by c.created_date ASC
order by c.created_date DESC
order by c.status desc
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

select c.*, m.nickname,
case when c.board_id is not null then b.title when c.recipe_id is not null then r.title end as title,
case when c.recipe_id is not null then r.thumbnail else 'no_board.png' end as thumbnail,
case when c.board_id is not null then '게시글' when c.recipe_id is not null then '레시피' end as type
from comment c join member m on c.member_id = m.member_id left join recipe r on r.recipe_id = c.recipe_id left join board b on b.board_id = c.board_id where comment_id = #{comment_id}
mapper.update: update comment set status = #{status} where comment_id = #{comment_id}
